summary: Structure as Context is the umbrella principle; the linked patterns make locality, unit size, boundaries, navigation and project shape concrete.

items.text: Implement structural locality by colocating a feature's code, tests, documentation and configuration in one navigable folder.
Keep structural units small enough to load, reason about and change without spilling the active context budget.
Turn module boundaries into compact context boundaries through minimal, explicit and stable interfaces.
Expose the intended structure through local README entry points so agents do not have to reconstruct purpose and navigation from filenames.
Add a machine-readable project map when directory structure alone cannot communicate architecture, ownership and allowed dependencies.
See Prompt Enrichment Preprocessing for the related use case or counterpoint: Before execution, classify a generic request and visibly attach only the house context needed for that kind of work.
